title: Sgt Credland Memorial, St Andrew's Church, Billingborough
location_name: St Andrew's Church, Billingborough, Lincolnshire, England
memorial_details: St Andrew's Church, Billingborough, contains a stone WW2 roll of honour tablet (seven names) and at least three private memorials. One private memorial is specifically dedicated to Sgt Ralph Hilton Credland RAFVR, son of Arthur and Rose A. Credland of Billingborough. The project seed describes the memorial as a font cover — this form of memorial is known in Lincolnshire churches of the period, but the attribution has not been confirmed from open sources and requires a site visit or access to church records. Sgt Credland is commemorated on the Runnymede Air Forces Memorial, indicating no known grave.
contributor: Keith Binley, Bomber Command Memorial Register
narrative:
Ralph Hilton Credland was a sergeant in the RAF Volunteer Reserve from Billingborough who was killed in action. His date of death appears in one source as 28 January 1943 and in another as 28 January 1942; this discrepancy has not been resolved and the crash date field is omitted here to avoid stating an unverified fact. Credland has no known grave; his name is inscribed on the Runnymede Air Forces Memorial, Surrey. His parents arranged for a private memorial to be placed in St Andrew's Church.

Sgt Credland's unit, aircraft type, and loss circumstances have not been recovered from open sources. His squadron and serial number remain unknown pending archive research. The form of the private memorial — described as a font cover in the project's research notes — is a recognised commemorative form in Lincolnshire churches of the period but requires direct verification.
community_connection: Private memorial placed by the Credland family. St Andrew's Church maintains the memorial.
